# Mote v1.0.1

Mote v1.0.1 is a small quality update focused on safer group deletion, more stable Markdown editing and cleaner reading on mobile and desktop.

## Highlights

- Added a `Delete group and notes` action that moves notes in the deleted group to Trash, while `Delete group only` continues to move notes to Inbox.
- Reduced large Markdown editor scroll jumps while typing.
- Invalid or unsupported Mermaid blocks now fall back inline instead of surfacing a global syntax-error UI that can disrupt the app.
- Improved Markdown Preview spacing so sections are easier to distinguish without over-spacing consecutive headings.
- Kept the mobile save status and Favorite button on the same row for a more compact note header.

## Data and compatibility

- Existing notes and groups remain stored locally in IndexedDB.
- No migration is required from v1.0.0.
- The release keeps the existing local-first architecture and browser-based backup/export flow.

## Try Mote

https://mote.namnth.com

## Upgrade notes

This is a backward-compatible patch release. Existing v1.0.0 data can be used as-is.
